gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-khudawa: Loud, unbuttoned letters in lines that never thin out, all Grandstander. Noto Sans Khudawadi is the quiet counterweight, its rounds left unlatched and its capitals barely above the lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Grandstander keeps every stroke at one thickness, bold and open. Where the heading shouts, Noto Sans Lepcha does its best work in sturdy lowercase and curves with a wide opening.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Grandstander is all swagger, with a stroke weight that never varies. Noto Sans Limbu keeps paragraphs moving, its wide-gaping curves and tall-bodied small letters easy on the eye.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Letters sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, bold and open, set the tone for Grandstander up front. Noto Sans Lydian, the sans-serif below, keeps capitals barely taller than its lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-mahajan: Not one thin hairline appears anywhere in Grandstander, just thick, confident strokes with open shapes. Noto Sans Mahajani stands beneath it, its tall lowercase and funnel-wide e lending steady footing.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-mende-k: Expressive and flat-drawn, Grandstander has no contrast in its letterforms and holds its shapes open. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve, so a full paragraph of its tall lowercase reads cleanly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-meroiti: Tubular strokes like bent copper pipe give Grandstander its bold, expressive look and keep its letters open. Noto Sans Meroitic reads smoothly, see-through openings and lowercase filling each line like capitals.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-mro: Uninterrupted monoline strokes make Grandstander feel bold and expressive, with letters held open. Noto Sans Mro sets words dense and tall in the middle, with large entrances into each letter that keep paragraphs legible.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Grandstander is a bold display face with no thin parts and no swelling anywhere. Noto Sans Nushu brings a towering lowercase height and terminals held far from the stroke body.
gen-fs-pencerio-fs-spline-sans: Pencerio is a formal calligraphic hand, better suited to a quick phrase. Spline Sans carries the paragraphs, its strokes identical in weight and its curve ends parted wide from the stems.
